title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 395 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Looks pretty quiet right now. 🌎

A broad darker coronal region and several bright active areas are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clearly identifiable CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
